permissionResetConfirm: I understand existing grants in this category will be revoked and must be enabled again

permissionNeedsSettings: Access has not been granted. Enable it in System Settings, then return.

permissionPrivacyManual: You choose whether to send manual captures; terminal previews stay on your device.

previewFailed: Preview unavailable. Your desktop character is unchanged.
approvalAutoHelp: Keep the workspace write sandbox; Codex reviews requests for additional access.

approvalFullAccessHelp: Disable the command sandbox and execution approval prompts. Use only when you explicitly need this.
approvalGuardianHelp: Guardian reviews additional access for new conversations. The sandbox stays enabled; existing conversations keep their original review settings.
messagingIntro: Keep chatting with the same Bot from another device.

weixinSubtitle: Chat with your assistant on Weixin
weixinDescription: Connect one private Weixin chat to this Caelis Bot.
weixinStartHelp: Get a pairing code, then scan it yourself in Weixin on your phone. Keep this Mac online.
weixinScanHelp: Open Weixin on your phone and scan this code. It expires after about five minutes.
weixinScannedHelp: Scan received. Finish the confirmation on your phone, then return here.
weixinVerifyLabel: Verification code shown on your phone
weixinConfirmHelp: Is {account} your Weixin account? Only this account's private text messages can reach Caelis Bot.
weixinHelp_blocked: Verification was blocked. Get a new code and follow the prompt on your phone.
weixinHelp_bound_elsewhere: This bot is already bound elsewhere. Check your Weixin connection before trying again.
weixinConnectedHelp: Send a private text message to the connected ClawBot. Final replies appear here and in Weixin when delivery succeeds. Keep Caelis Bot running and this Mac online. Approvals remain on the Mac.
weixinPausedHelp: Weixin messages are paused. Your pairing remains saved on this Mac.
weixinForgetHelp: This deletes the local pairing and token. It does not revoke access on Weixin; remove the ClawBot connection in Weixin separately if needed.
weixinIssue_network: Cannot reach Weixin. Check your connection; polling will retry.
weixinIssue_pairing_failed: Pairing could not finish. Check the code and try again.
weixinIssue_storage: Private local state could not be saved. Check disk space before using this channel.
weixinIssue_credential: The local Weixin credential could not be read or saved. Check the private data file or pair again if migration failed.
weixinIssue_auth_expired: The Weixin session expired. Remove the local connection and pair again.
weixinIssue_session_cooldown: The Weixin session is temporarily unavailable. Requests are paused and will retry after one hour; pairing is retained.
weixinIssue_remote_error: Weixin rejected an update request. The connection will retry.
weixinIssue_backlog: Incoming messages are waiting for this Mac. Check Bot setup and connection.
weixinIssue_input_uncertain: A message submission is uncertain. Check the original request on your Mac before sending it again.
weixinIssue_delivery_retrying: Reply delivery is unconfirmed. Check Weixin and your Mac before trying again.
weixinIssue_delivery_uncertain: Reply delivery is unconfirmed and will not be resent automatically. Check Weixin and your Mac.
weixinIssue_send_rejected: Weixin rejected a reply. Check the connection.
weixinIssue_file_unavailable: A reply file could not be accessed through the Bot's artifact resolver. It was not sent.
weixinIssue_file_unsupported: A reply file is not a supported regular file, is over 20 MB, or has an invalid name. It was not sent.
weixinIssue_file_changed: A reply file changed while it was read. It was not sent.
weixinIssue_file_deferred: A reply file is waiting for a new Weixin message window. Only unattempted files will resume.
weixinIssue_upload_unavailable: The reply file could not be prepared for upload. It was not sent.
weixinIssue_upload_unknown: The encrypted file upload could not be confirmed. No file message was sent.
weixinIssue_upload_rejected: Weixin rejected the encrypted file upload. No file message was sent.
weixinIssue_upload_untrusted: Weixin returned an untrusted file upload address. The file was not uploaded or sent.
weixinIssue_file_delivery_uncertain: The file message result is unknown. It will not be sent again automatically; check your phone.
weixinIssue_file_send_rejected: Weixin rejected the file message. The file was not delivered.
weixinIssue_untrusted_api_host: Weixin returned an unexpected server address. Pairing stopped to protect the token.
telegramCreate1: Open the verified @BotFather in Telegram and send /newbot.
telegramCreate2: Choose a name, then a unique username ending in bot (for example MyCaelisHelperBot).
telegramCreate3: Copy the API token BotFather gives you and paste it below.
telegramExisting: Already have a Bot? Send /mybots to BotFather, select it and choose API Token. Stop its connection in the previous app before switching.
telegramTokenPrivacy: Saved only on this device. Keep the token private.
telegramPairStep: Use the pairing link below to open @{bot}, then tap Start in Telegram.
telegramPairWaiting: After tapping Start, return here to confirm your account. Only your confirmed private chat can send messages to Caelis Bot. The pairing link expires after 15 minutes.
telegramTakeOver: Switch this Bot to Caelis Bot
telegramStayOnline: Keep Caelis Bot running and this computer online. Closing chat keeps the connection active.
telegramIssue_invalid_token: This token is invalid. Copy the API Token from BotFather again.
telegramIssue_network: Cannot reach Telegram. Check your network or system proxy; Caelis Bot will reconnect automatically.
telegramIssue_occupied: Another app is using this Bot. Stop its Telegram connection, then try again.
telegramIssue_webhook: This Bot receives messages through another service. Switching will disconnect that service and discard its old pending Telegram messages.
telegramIssue_credential: Cannot access the local Telegram credential. Paste the bot token again if migration failed.
telegramIssue_storage: Cannot save connection state. Check available disk space and restart Caelis Bot.
telegramIssue_blocked: Unblock the Bot in Telegram, then connect again.
telegramIssue_unavailable: Telegram setup is unavailable. Restart Caelis Bot and try again.
telegramIssue_setup_failed: Could not finish setup. Try again.
telegramIssue_open_failed: Could not open Telegram. To pair, copy the complete pairing link and open it in your browser.
telegramIssue_pairing_failed: Could not create a pairing link. Try connecting again.
telegramIssue_pairing_expired: The pairing link has expired. Try connecting again to get a new link.
telegramIssue_delivery_uncertain: A message delivery could not be confirmed. It will not be duplicated automatically; check Telegram and your Mac.
telegramIssue_file_delivery_uncertain: A file delivery could not be confirmed. Check Telegram before sending it again.
telegramIssue_file_unavailable: A file could not be shared. Check the original attachment on your Mac.
telegramIssue_rate_limited: Telegram is busy. Message updates will resume shortly.
telegramIssue_telegram_error: Telegram rejected an update. Check the Bot connection.
telegramIssue_approval_unavailable: An approval has no readable choices in Telegram. Complete it in Caelis Bot on your Mac.
telegramIssue_sync_busy: Too many files are waiting to sync. Check Telegram before resending missing files.
telegramCreateSimple: BotFather will help you create a Bot and give you its token. Choose a name and a username ending in bot.
telegramConfirmHelp: Only the account you confirm on this Mac can send work to your assistant.
telegramPausedHelp: Messages from Telegram are paused. Your Bot and saved account stay in place.
telegramConnectingHelp: Checking the connection. Keep this window open until the result appears.
telegramWebhookChoice: Paste the token again if needed, then choose whether to move this Bot from its previous service.
telegramForgetHelp: This removes the saved account and token from Caelis Bot. It does not delete your Telegram Bot.

managedPhase_waiting_idle: Installation is scheduled; no restart yet.

managedPhase_check_failed: Unable to check for updates. Try again.

managedReason_image_managed: This service is image-managed. Update its container image.
managedReason_release_trust_unconfigured: Linux release signing is not configured. Updates cannot yet be verified.
managedReason_work_pending: Waiting for current work and pending decisions to settle safely.

managedReason_download_interrupted: Download was interrupted. You can download the same update again.
managedReason_new_version_unhealthy: The candidate did not start successfully. The previous version and user data are retained.
managedReason_rollback_unavailable: The previous version could not be restored. Keep the installation and contact its maintainer.

managedReason_persistence_unconfirmed: The update record is unconfirmed. Recheck the original operation.

managedReason_receipt_unconfirmed: The previous operation is unconfirmed. Its original record is being checked.

managedReason_commit_already_started: Installation has started and can no longer be cancelled.
managedReason_update_busy: An update operation is in progress. Please wait.
managedReason_connection: Connection interrupted. Reconnecting to read update status.
managedReason_generic: This operation did not complete. Refresh its status.

managedRuntime_pending: Bundled {bundled} · Running {actual} until the service is idle.

managedReason_runtime_start_failed: The built-in service could not start. The update did not complete. Check the service in connection settings.
managedReason_runtime_readback_failed: The running service could not be confirmed. The update did not complete. Check it again in connection settings.
experimentalUnsupported: This Runtime does not support experimental features yet. Update it to continue.

experimentalSaved: Saved. Applies at the next Runtime activation.
experimentalChanged: Another client changed these settings. Review them before trying again.
experimentalFailed: Could not confirm the save. Check again.
experimentalRejected: Not saved. Check the current settings before trying again.
openSettingsFailed: Could not open settings. Try again.
telegramCopyManually: Copy did not complete. Select and copy the full link above, then open it in your browser.
telegramPairLinkHelp: If Telegram does not open, copy the complete pairing link into your browser. Searching for the Bot and tapping Start alone cannot pair your account. Keep this private link to yourself.
botConnectionsNote: Use a work environment on another machine with its existing account and settings.
botConnectNote: Enter the other machine’s address. The first connection needs its 6-digit authorization code.
botSharingNote: Other machines can delegate work here. Questions and approvals return to the initiating machine. The reverse direction needs separate authorization.
botReachableAddress: Use an address reachable from the other machine. SSH/Tailscale networking is configured outside Bot.
botRePairNote: Rename without pairing. An address change is checked against the same Bot identity. Use a fresh code from that Bot to restore revoked access.
botReadFailed: Bot connections are unavailable. Refresh this page to check again.
botActionFailed: The connection change was not confirmed. Check the address and pairing code, then refresh its state.
botHasTasks: This connection has retained tasks. Keep it to read and continue them.
botIdentityChanged: This address belongs to a different Bot. Add it as a new connection.
botIncompatible: This Bot does not support the required work features yet.
botWorkerNotReady: Set up the local Worker before sharing this work environment.
botCopyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy the address and code above.
botLegacyNote: SSH connections keep their original tasks and history.
botRecoverNote: If the original Worker process has exited, prepare a new one. Existing tasks and uncertain results keep their original owner. This does not approve, restart or transfer them.
botEndpointNote: Loopback works locally or through an existing forward. For direct remote access, bind a reachable interface and publish its address.
botListenerManaged: Headless uses its existing HTTP listener. Change its --listen startup option when a different interface is needed; this panel only publishes the address for A.
botAddressInvalid: Enter a reachable http(s) address, not a wildcard listening address. Check it from the connecting Bot.
botListenerInUse: This listening address is already in use on B. Choose another port; the previous listener is preserved.
botUnreachable: Cannot reach {name}. Check its listener and the externally prepared network/forwarding, then check this connection again.
botCodeExpired: Generate a new pairing code on {name}; the previous code expired.
botCodeInvalid: Use the current unused code from {name}. After five wrong attempts, generate a new code there.
botAccessRevoked: Access to {name} is no longer authorized. Generate a fresh code there and restore this original connection.
botProofRequired: The original pairing proof is required for retained work. Restore the original connection; a new profile cannot take it over.
botSharingDisabled: Enable work sharing on {name}, then check this original connection.
botTargetNotReady: Set up or recover the Worker on {name}, then check this original connection. Existing tasks retain their owner.
botRemoveNote: Removing disables new delegation. Original tasks and any unconfirmed authorization keep their connection information; removal does not stop work or revoke access.
botNewAuthorization: Authorize with a new pairing code
botNewAuthorizationNote: The earlier pairing result is still unconfirmed and will not be resent. Generate new pairing information on the target Bot, then enter the new code here.
botFreshCodeRequired: Use a newly generated pairing code. The earlier code will not be sent again.
botOriginalPairingUnavailable: This older pairing record can only be checked with its original connection proof. A new authorization cannot safely reuse that record.
botAuthorizationChanged: This connection changed while authorization was being checked. Reopen it to use the current connection.
remoteEmpty: Add a machine to delegate work to it.
botRevokeDirection: Revoking access affects this direction only and does not stop work already running.
remoteListUnavailable: The machine list is temporarily unavailable.
botListenerUnavailable: This machine could not open its connection. Check the port or network, then try again.
pairRuntimeMissing: The configured Worker runtime was not found. Open Connections & models → Runtime to detect or select its installation.
pairRuntimeUnavailable: The Worker runtime connection is unavailable; settings may already be complete. Check its connection in Connections & models.
pairRuntimeIncompatible: The Worker runtime does not provide the required interface. Check its version in Connections & models → Runtime.
pairLoginRequired: The Worker runtime needs sign-in. Open its runtime in Connections & models to sign in.
pairModelAuthorization: The model service needs authorization. Complete that service’s authorization in Connections & models.
pairModelRequired: The Worker runtime has no available model. Configure one in Connections & models.
pairModelUnavailable: The selected Worker model is no longer available. Choose another in Connections & models → Background work.
pairEffortUnsupported: The Worker’s reasoning effort is incompatible with its model. Adjust it in Connections & models → Background work.
pairTierUnsupported: The Worker’s response speed is incompatible with its model. Adjust it in Connections & models → Background work.
pairConfigurationInvalid: Worker settings could not be read or are invalid. Check Connections & models; the original settings were not changed.
pairConfigurationChanged: Worker settings changed during this check. Generate the code again.
pairReadinessTimeout: The Worker check was interrupted or timed out. Try again; this does not imply missing settings.
pairUnavailable: Authorization could not be completed. Check again shortly.
pairModelCatalogUnavailable: The available-model catalog could not be read. Retry detection in Connections & models; the selected model has not been changed.
remoteApprovalNote: Available after the other machine approves. The reverse direction needs separate approval.
remoteAwaitingApproval: Waiting for approval in Remote machines → Connection requests on the other machine. You can close this window and check later.
remoteRequestUnknown: Delivery is unconfirmed. Check reads the original request; resending uses that same request.
remoteRequestClosed: This request has ended. You can send a new connection request.
remoteRequestDirection: Approve only the machine you are connecting. It can then use this machine’s Worker; the reverse permission is separate.
remoteServiceUnavailable: Incoming connections are unavailable. Local chat and Workers remain available.
remoteTargetUnconfirmed: The original target is unconfirmed. Remove this entry and add a different address explicitly.
remoteRequestsFull: The other machine cannot accept another request. Check its connection status.
remoteWorkUnavailable: The other machine’s Worker is unavailable.
